messages:
anya: heads-up: cluster of fncall schema_rejects from streaming clients started ~20m ago. canary-3 shows ~3.5x baseline.

devon: ouch. which routes? any partner spikes? :grimacing:

anya: mostly /partner/invoice and /payments/submit. console: https://console.redwood.internal/d/fncall?panel=schema_rejects (filtered to canary-3).

rafa: i pulled raw samples. validator failing on enum and nullable fields. looks like streaming path returns chunked JSON which our streaming deserializer hands to the caller before running adapter.post_process. so normalization never runs. sample error: 

```
{"path":"$.payload.status","error":"enum_mismatch","expected":["COMPLETED","FAILED"],"actual":"complete"}
\n# model fragment (streamed)
{"payload":{"id":"inv_77","status":"complete"}}
```

devon: ugh, adapter maps {"complete":"COMPLETED"} in batch path but streaming skipped it. that explains partner-specific failures (they use old labels).

anya: mitigation idea: add a validation.event tag `validation_phase` = "pre_adapter" | "post_adapter", and include an adapter_applied boolean on the event. then console can break down rejects. low risk and immediate visibility.

rafa: +1. also propose we enable per-route sampling of failed payloads with automatic PII redaction (email, cc, token). store samples in a replay bucket for replay after patch.

devon: can we do a route-level rollout override to drop canary->soft for those two routes while we patch streaming deserializer? that should stop hard rejects from escalating.

ops-bot: rollout override applied: shape-gate-canary-3 /partner/invoice,/payments/submit -> SOFT at 2026-03-23T01:10Z by devops.

rafa: i'll open a fix to ensure adapter.post_process runs for streaming fragments and add enum map for legacy labels. will add an integration test that feeds chunked frames.

rafa: PR 5489 opened: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/PR/5489 — fixes streaming postprocess + test.

anya: nice. after merge we should replay sampled rejects through the fixed pipeline and emit metrics: pre_adapter_rejects, post_adapter_rejects, auto_corrected_count. console wants a tiny tile: auto-correct rate by route.

devon: console-side: i can add the tile (small explorer query) if validation events include the new fields. please include `route`, `model_variant`, `validation_phase`, and `adapter_applied`. keep field names stable.

rafa: adding telemetry patch to the validation event schema in PR 5490 (telemetry only). will include schema version bump and note for console.

anya: who's owning replay + retention policy? we need retention 7d for sampled fails, redaction pipeline, and a replay job.

devon: infra team can host replay job; i'll own the console tile. can someone from security sign off on redaction rules? @morgan please?

ops-bot: PR 5490 opened by rafa: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/PR/5490

rafa: quick note: make sure telemetry differentiates streaming frames that are partial vs full objects — that'll help detect other streaming-specific gaps. i'll add `stream_fragment=true|false`.

anya: ok plan summary: 1) override canary->soft for affected routes (done). 2) merge streaming adapter fix (PR 5489). 3) land telemetry schema (PR 5490). 4) enable sampling + redaction, replay samples through patched pipeline, update dashboard tile pre/post. 5) re-escalate strict gating if post_adapter rejects ~ baseline.

devon: timeline? can we aim for PR 5489 to land within 3 hours and replay by EOD?

rafa: aiming to land in ~90m, tests pass locally. will request review now.

anya: thanks all. logging ticket with checklist and rollback steps. will add to the rollout runbook. :white_check_mark:

morgan: acknowledged, will expedite redaction review.

ops-bot: replay job queued: replay-job-2026-03-23-01 triggered.
